camera.subject: Wide basement discovery: Wide night view deep inside a stone underground room; Fawkes by several barrels as officials with lanterns enter. Establish room/barrels/light.
camera.reason: Fawkes and barrels central; officials at doorway; no explosion.

camera.subject: Searchers reach the barrels: From the doorway toward the same room; Fawkes beside the barrels, officials approaching through lantern light.
camera.reason: Same underground room and Fawkes as S01; no new action beyond search/discovery.

camera.subject: Fawkes identity reveal: Unbound side-lit portrait of Fawkes in a dim stone passage; an official remains out of focus.
camera.reason: Same fictionalized Fawkes as S01; this is the identity reveal, with no visible restraint, labels or readable documents.

camera.subject: Parliament expected: Empty, symmetrical House of Lords chamber prepared for an expected opening, central perspective.
camera.reason: No attendees; present the event as expected, not completed.

camera.subject: Members of both Houses: Low wide view along empty parliamentary benches and central aisle.
camera.reason: Same hall as S04; no attendees or blast.

camera.subject: One planned explosion: Architectural cross-section: powder room beneath the empty chamber; a restrained Fawkes figure in foreground.
camera.reason: Intent only; no flame/blast; clear spatial relation.

camera.subject: The name remembered: A simple Guy Fawkes effigy among distant figures at a later bonfire, framed as a brief foreshadowing image.
camera.reason: Later remembrance motif, clearly separated from 1605 events; return to it at S43.

camera.subject: England has a new monarch: James I in a restrained early Stuart palace interior, three-quarter view.
camera.reason: Establish James consistently; no invented accession ceremony.

camera.subject: Hopes under James and Elizabeth: Two separate royal portraits in the same quiet palace room: James foreground, Elizabeth portrait on wall.
camera.reason: The rulers are not presented as meeting; no text.

camera.subject: Fines and hunted priests: A Catholic before an official desk with coins and closed papers; a priest distant in a shadowed street passage.
camera.reason: Two restrained manifestations of restrictions; no invented arrest or fine amount.

camera.subject: Hopes disappointed; a small group acts: A few men in a closed room around a plain wooden table, slightly elevated wide view.
camera.reason: Specific plotters only; they do not stand for all Catholics.

camera.subject: Not all Catholics joined: Ordinary Catholic household in foreground, small conspirator meeting visible separately through a distant doorway.
camera.reason: Make the people visually distinct; no shared group or collective guilt.

camera.subject: Robert Catesby leads: Catesby at the center of a small table meeting; the others face him.
camera.reason: Establish a consistent fictionalized Catesby identity and clothing.

camera.subject: Catesby’s plan: Catesby’s hands beside a plain, unlabelled silhouette sketch of the Parliament building; his face beyond.
camera.reason: No device schematic, writing or explosion.

camera.subject: Fawkes joins the group: One Fawkes with four visually distinct conspirators in a candlelit room, composed as a small ensemble.
camera.reason: Fawkes is shown once; Catesby remains visually central; no oath or invented ceremony.

camera.subject: Guarding the powder: Fawkes stands watch beside stored barrels, low camera at barrel height, hands relaxed and visible.
camera.reason: Same basement/barrels as S01/S02; no ignition.

camera.subject: Preparing to leave: A Jacobean courtyard with saddled horses and conspirators preparing for travel, seen in a wide side view.
camera.reason: Travel preparation only; distinct from the table-based planning scenes.

camera.subject: Hoped-for uprising: A few conspirators lean over a blank map sheet, seen from above/over shoulder.
camera.reason: No names or invented map content; planned action only.

camera.subject: Princess Elizabeth: Young Princess Elizabeth alone in a calm palace doorway, centered medium view.
camera.reason: Separate from conspirators; no pursuit or capture.

camera.subject: The hoped-for succession: Three conspirators observe a portrait of Princess Elizabeth in a quiet room, seen over their shoulders.
camera.reason: They are planning; Elizabeth remains separate and is not shown captured.

camera.subject: Powder moved into the cellar: Conspirators roll intact wooden barrels through a stone threshold into the rented cellar.
camera.reason: Same cellar and barrels; no restraints, ignition or exact barrel count.

camera.subject: Parliament date delayed: Long corridor ending at closed chamber doors, empty foreground.
camera.reason: Same hall geometry as S04/S05; no invented calendar.

camera.subject: The warning arrives: A folded blank letter beside intact powder barrels as two conspirator silhouettes leave the cellar.
camera.reason: No legible writing, sender or arrest; maintain the cellar/barrels continuity.

camera.subject: Monteagle receives warning: Lord Monteagle reads an opened anonymous letter, side medium view; face and letter centered.
camera.reason: Establish Monteagle; no legible text.

camera.subject: Letter reaches royal authorities: Close view of hands passing the same folded letter in a formal interior.
camera.reason: Same paper; no signatures or added marks.

camera.subject: Sender unknown: The letter alone on a table, overhead view, dark empty space around it.
camera.reason: Do not depict a sender, suspect or writing process.

camera.subject: The conspirators read the warning: Catesby and companions read a blank letter in a close candlelit room composition.
camera.reason: Same small group; no readable writing; decision is not yet shown as a search.

camera.subject: Risk of a search: Side architectural view linking stone corridor, stair and the powder room below, no people.
camera.reason: Represents a danger, not a completed search.

camera.subject: They continue despite the warning: Catesby and Fawkes remain with the other conspirators after reading the warning, in a restrained candlelit interior.
camera.reason: Resolve to proceed; no search or arrest yet.

camera.subject: The night search: Official searchers inspect the barrels in a lantern-lit stone cellar; Fawkes remains nearby, not yet restrained.
camera.reason: Same room and barrels as earlier; the arrest follows in S31.

camera.subject: Fawkes is arrested: Officials restrain Fawkes beside the powder barrels in the cellar doorway.
camera.reason: Same Fawkes and cellar; no explosion, smoke or damage.

camera.subject: The explosion never happened: Close object view of intact barrels in empty lantern-lit room.
camera.reason: Same powder; no ignition, smoke, damage or blast.

camera.subject: Catesby seeks supporters: Catesby and a few companions on an open road outside the city, broad empty space.
camera.reason: Small group only; no crowd or invented encounter.

camera.subject: Fugitives are caught: A distant, restrained encounter between officials and a few fugitives on a country road.
camera.reason: No invented location, number of casualties or dialogue.

camera.subject: Catesby dies in the pursuit: A distant country-road aftermath with a covered body after the shootout and a few figures, no visible injury.
camera.reason: Non-graphic; the body is not used to invent additional combat detail.

camera.subject: Fawkes in the Tower: Distant exterior of the Tower of London from the river; stone walls fill the center.
camera.reason: Location establishing view; do not imply a specific cell.

camera.subject: The torture order: King James and officials in a restrained interior, with a closed cell door beyond; no torture shown.
camera.reason: The royal order authorizing torture is the story beat; no procedure or suffering is depicted.

camera.subject: Survivors executed: Distant, restrained view of a wooden platform and a few condemned figures.
camera.reason: No exact number, mechanism or sequence; no gore.

camera.subject: Catholics after the plot: Ordinary Catholic townspeople in a quiet street, distinct individuals, one foreground face.
camera.reason: Return to non-conspirators; avoid collective guilt.

camera.subject: November 5 becomes a day of thanksgiving: A church congregation listens in a quiet service, viewed from behind with bowed heads.
camera.reason: A public day of thanksgiving; no conflation with the earlier political oath requirements.

camera.subject: Bonfires begin the tradition: A daylight town square with a prepared bonfire pile and distant observers.
camera.reason: Later November 5 custom, after the thanksgiving beat; no specific historical year.

camera.subject: Fireworks over the town: Very wide elevated night view over rooftops with distant fireworks and scattered bonfire glows.
camera.reason: Later custom, not the night of the 1605 plot.

camera.subject: Fawkes effigy and final memory: Broad low evening view of a Guy Fawkes effigy on a bonfire, observers distant.
camera.reason: Later tradition; final motif echoes S07; the Nuviko traveler is only a separate guide cameo if visible.
